notes.title: New 2.8 update and 20%off bundle
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/8caf18c2f7e6f6bc48e9774eb154f2727dc9bf30.png[/img]

Hello comrades and please welcome our 2019 2.8 update. 

- Optimization! We have fixed the problem for those who experienced problems with black screen upon the game launch. You should not experience this issue any more. If you still have this issue please take a look on this topic - https://steamcommunity.com/app/583590/discussions/0/1735464254638888130/

- Game must load and finish a bit faster ( it still takes long time though )

- Leaders suits now properly screen bonus information in the game lobby when you choose Historic play mode

- Fixed broken bonus calculation for Space Race in tech tree

- Fixed some broken bonuses for Global Consequences

- Many other very small and incorrect data fixes

We wish you pleasant global domination! 

For those who enjoy The Cold War Era we prepared the special bundle package. Don't miss the opportunity to have TCWE collection with great discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10404/The_Cold_War_Era_Bundle/

Check another game from Alina Digital for global domination in fantasy world

https://store.steampowered.com/app/765470/The_Great_Fantasy_Struggle

notes.title: 2.2 update and DLC Armageddon is released!
notes.content:
Update 2.2 version

- wasd navigation for map

- political points automatic invest in budget growth at the end of each year ( you don't waste it if you have forgotten to use it during one year )

- rebalance of funds for many global consequences events. The financial penalties are lower now

- ground facility technologies for space race makes launches 1% cheaper, not 2% as it was before 

- Reagan and Gorbachev AI now can invest global consequences in two different events now instead of two points per event

- Buttons for riot and parade are not active if an action not possible ( there was some confusion )


DLC Armageddon (turn on in options)

- Nuclear destruction victory condition

- Nuclear technologies

http://store.steampowered.com/app/759170/Armageddon__TCWE/

notes.title: May update, part 2
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Today I'm very happy to share with you some more of screenshots from my latest test game. It was absolutely amazing game! So much drama!

I played as Ronald Reagan, president of USA, in sandbox game. My counterpart in USSR was Gorbachev in 90's. It was historical accurate and therefore my fight against the Soviets was even more interesting.

I was losing 37 to 42 when "Crisis of the Elites" event has happened to USSR in 1991 ( it was also very historical accurate ). "Crisis of the Elites" was a real game changer event! It raised opposition in USSR and I used my advanced spy network there to destabilize local situation and lead to the local Civil War. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/47fd61e5166c11a19730b25858debf72a5eee1da.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/d0d0db309be7794e41bd041557d7e1a049345ba9.png[/img]

But mighty Soviet Union finished the Civil War pretty fast. USSR had great global influence and budget. It helped them to stay alive without harm consequences after Civil War and "Crisis of the Elites".  And they still lead in scores. So I had to come up with another plan to be able to do my best to win before the game finish in 2000.

My plan was simple but very hard to do. "We will do it because it is hard!" someone whispered me to my ear.  So I decided to steal China with its 4 scores from USSR.

I started different wars around the globe and significantly increased spending to my military. Unfortunately I lost some of my Global Influence to Mr.Gorbachev and it helped the Soviets to dominate in Firepower. But I got more military! Much more. So, yeah, they destroyed a lot of my military but I always had twice more to replace!

Around 1998 I started two Civil Wars at the same time. One in USSR and another in China. On the screen below you can see August 1998. One year and a half before the game is over. Soviets in China were losing most of the military and had nothing to replace already. China was close to defeat. The score - 38 to 44. If China will survive I lost!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/612b32fdec110b9d5e913fa05894dac2efb2223f.png[/img]

In the late 1998 I researched super modern Air and Ground units. It helped me to change combat Firepower to my favor. Soviets couldn't handle two wars any more and they used most of their military mostly in their home country. And, finally, in December 1999 ( one month=one turn before the game is over ) China joins the world of Democracy! I won with the final score 42-40! 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/86d4f7a1b95ff50af3a7f49ec8890f628eb52a0b.png[/img]

It was really fun game. Stay tuned for more screenshots in July!
Max Sprin

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/thecoldwarera

https://www.facebook.com/TheColdWarEra/

https://twitter.com/AlinaDigitalDev

https://www.youtube.com/user/alinadigital

http://store.steampowered.com/app/504280/The_Cold_War_Era/

notes.title: May update, part 1
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

In this update I'm going to tell you about some of Global Consequences events. I noted in my previous update that the event "Global shoot" has helped me to win my game.

Today I'm going to tell you something "Unthinkable". Here is Wiki link for those who forgot what it is - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Unthinkable

"Operation Unthinkable was a code name of two related plans of a conflict between the Western Allies and the Soviet Union. The plannings were ordered by British Prime Minister Winston Churchill in 1945 and developed by the British Armed Forces' Joint Planning Staff at the end of World War II in Europe."

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447343/50f6214c9f60d4504576386a7d0add34b06efd34.png[/img]

In my game I played President Kennedy and it was my great luck I had five events to my favor ( you can see five icons on the top left side of the screen ).  One of the event is "Unthinkable". This event started wars in all Soviet countries in Europe and my alliance military invaded to them ( without taking it from my country military pool ). So, Soviet Union had a hard time fighting this "Unthinkable" war in Europe in the middle of 1955.

Some of you may ask me - "What has happened with Hungary, why it is blue on the map?". The answer is simple, here it is - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hungarian_Revolution_of_1956

Hungarian revolution was another Global Consequence event that happened to my(American) favor in this game. When revolution happened I managed to provide them some more of my "support" and Hungary "decided" to join my alliance. Everything was honest and democratic ( khm khm ).

This why Hungary avoided this global "Unthinkable" mess in Europe. It wasn't part of the Soviets at the time when global war started.

Next week I'm going to tell you the story about "Crisis of the Elites" which happened in USSR in one of my test games.

Stay tuned!

P.S. Play The Cold War Era while waiting for Arms Race!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/504280
